tests.name: all closed versioned schemas: positive, unknown key, missing field, duplicate JSON key
enums, decimal strings, UTF-8, canonical JSON, escaped duplicate keys
approved opaque input metadata and bounded imported representation
event chain append-only, fork/sequence/predecessor/mutation and time independence
H-F1 inaccessible canary, input plumbing and closure controls
H-F2 blocked and completed synthetic snapshots with full directories
H-F3 actual ID renaming, same-ID indeterminacy and many-sided mappings
H-F4 indeterminate mapping, findings, summaries and denominator
raw JSON/JSONL/Markdown selectors preserve exact selected bytes
additional leak encodings, alias, environment, and unknown ingress variants
freeze path/mode/hidden/quarantine mutations and detached-key rejection
mapping absent sides and unknown buckets cannot disappear
CLI refuses replay, provider, release, attestation and reference operations
synthetic ZIP extraction selects only approved bytes and rejects malicious metadata
visibility derivation closure, generations, and unapproved roots
manual conditional reviewer, L3/L2S pass reuse, normalizer pass and no fallback
deterministic repeated R01-R09 reports and independently rebuilt fixture identities
